subject: Request: Remote evidence review & Art.28/30 extracts — scheduling and access
messages:
From: Emma Patel <security@medisecure.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@medisecure.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 13:14:00 +0000
Subject: Remote evidence review request — DPS/Art.28 and Art.30 extracts

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for taking this on. As part of Medisecure's onboarding we need to complete a remote evidence review focused on: subprocessors list + onboarding evidence, the Art.30 processing activities ledger (sample extracts), and retention/erasure chain-of-custody for exported logs. Our security team prefers to run the review remotely next week (UTC mornings).

Can you confirm:
- Whether Redwood can provide an extract of the Art.30 ledger for the last 90 days (CSV or JSON)
- A short list of the subprocessors engaged for the hosted inference product and onboarding certs
- A proposed remote access method for live verification (e.g., remote screen share + time-limited log export or read-only access to a secure bucket)

We usually allocate 90 minutes for the session and will need one technical SME and one privacy SME. Let me know availability and any required NDAs / Docusign steps.

Best,
Emma Patel
Security & Compliance, Medisecure
security@medisecure.com

Attachments: none
From: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
To: Emma Patel <security@medisecure.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 21 Jun 2025 16:02:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Remote evidence review request — DPS/Art.28 and Art.30 extracts

Emma —

Thanks for the clear checklist. We can support all three items; proposed plan below:

1) Art.30 ledger extract
- We can produce a 90-day CSV export (fields: activity_id, data_categories, purpose, recipients, legal_basis, start_date, retention_policy_id). Attached is a small sample extract (redwood-art30-ledger-sample.csv).

2) Subprocessor inventory and onboarding evidence
- We'll provide the current subprocessor inventory plus onboarding certificates for the ones used by the hosted inference stack (e.g., cloud infra provider, KMS provider, monitoring vendor). We will bundle certified statements where available.

3) Remote verification / chain-of-custody
- Preferred option: Zoom-based screen-share with a short live demo where our infra SME exports the requested log slice to a time-limited signed URL in our secure bucket (read-only).
- Alternate: provide a pre-generated signed export and walk through provenance artifacts (checksums, KMS key IDs, and DocIDs).

We can host a 90-minute slot on Tue 24 Jun 09:00–10:30 UTC or Wed 25 Jun 10:30–12:00 UTC. Karhtik (engineering) and Soojin (privacy) will join as SMEs.

I'll also share a concise scope-and-playbook PDF for the session (attached). If you require a specific non-disclosure or a DocuSign flow, share the link and we'll triage with legal.

Thanks —
Lauren Bishop
Head of Privacy Operations, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com

Attachments: scope-and-playbook-remote-audit.pdf; redwood-art30-ledger-sample.csv
From: karthik.iyer@redwood.com
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com
Cc: soojin.lee@redwood.com, Emma Patel <security@medisecure.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2025 07:18:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Remote evidence review request — DPS/Art.28 and Art.30 extracts

Quick technical notes / constraints for the session:

- Art.30 extract: we can drop the full ledger but for production-sensitive columns (internal ticket IDs, dev notes) we'll mask values; fields needed for your assessment will be intact. Format: UTF-8 CSV, sha256 checksum provided.

- Chain-of-custody: we'll demonstrate the export provenance using KMS key metadata (KMS key aliases, key creation dates) and S3 signed URL expiry traces. For legal requests that need HSM audit logs we can provide a redacted view — but note lead time ~3 business days for HSM vendor extracts.

- Subprocessors: list will include engagement start dates and the contract reference (DPA ID). For any subprocessor you want deeper evidence on, flag the vendor and we'll surface the onboarding packet during the call.

Operational ask: please confirm the exact sample window you want (e.g., 2025-03-01 through 2025-05-31) so we can pre-generate exports and avoid doing heavyweight live queries during the call.

Karthik Iyer
Director, Infrastructure Reliability — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com
From: Emma Patel <security@medisecure.com>
To: lauren.bishop@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com
Cc: compliance@medisecure.com, soojin.lee@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 22 Jun 2025 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Remote evidence review request — DPS/Art.28 and Art.30 extracts

Thanks Lauren and team — this plan looks good. We'll take the Tue 24 Jun 09:00–10:30 UTC slot. Sample window: please provide 2025-03-01 through 2025-05-31.

A couple of small items:
- We'll have a completed NDA (DocuSign) to send before the call — I'll share the link by EOD today.
- If HSM-level audit logs are required we may request the 3 business day lead time; for now the CSV + KMS metadata is fine.
- Please upload the pre-generated artifacts to the Drive folder in your related_links and set view-only access for security@medisecure.com.

Confirmed attendees from Medisecure: Emma Patel (lead), Miguel Soto (infra), Priya Anand (privacy).

See you on Tue.

--
Emma Patel
Security & Compliance, Medisecure
security@medisecure.com

Attachments: NDA_Docusign_Instructions.pdf (will follow link)
